mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) may potentiate amoxicillin's effects and amoxicillin may rarely trigger hypertensive crisis when combined with MAOIs due to indirect sympathomimetic potential in some beta-lactams.
action: Monitor for signs of hypertensive crisis or serotonin syndrome; amoxicillin clavulanate is generally acceptable but use alternative antibiotics (e.g., fluoroquinolones) if clinically feasible.
